verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's MCP server grants an agent broad access to collections, requests, environments, and teams (hoppscotch-docs-10, hoppscotch-probe-3/6), but there is no evidence of any mechanism to scope or limit that access to least-privilege credentials for an agent — no API-key scoping, role restriction, or permission-limited token generation is documented anywhere in the pack.
